analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold at 48.4, now holding neutral at 55.6. MACD histogram improving from 0.1464 to 1.4539. Higher Low pattern confirmed with 5-day low ($251.08) above 20-day low ($244.30). SMA5 ($258.45) broke above SMA20 ($252.32) and is holding as support. Weekly ADX at 14.0 indicates a non-trending phase, susceptible to shock moves. 4H RSI shows signs of cooling from neutral upper band at 57.9. Volume ratio of 0.69 suggests low conviction. Quantitative engine shows 70 buy vs 17 sell, favoring buys. Aligns with overall market sentiment. Position is at 1x target allocation, next move is leverage.
